title: Quarry Bank Scarecrow Festival
venue: Quarry Bank, Styal, Wilmslow, Cheshire
cost: Free event with normal admission; optional scarecrow trail £2.50
description: Quarry Bank's autumn festival runs daily from 10:30am to 5pm with a scarecrow trail, storytelling, crafts, games and indoor and outdoor family activities. Event activities are free with normal property admission; the outdoor scarecrow trail costs £2.50 extra.

title: Reddish Vale Halloween Pumpkin Festival
venue: Reddish Vale Farm, Stockport
description: Pumpkin patch, carving cavern, wand-making, games, magic, roaming characters, farm activities, indoor play and a nature trail. The organiser's live booking basket is the safest place to check the current total price and extras.

title: Deckchair Care Welcome Café
venue: Gatley United Reformed Church, Elm Road, Gatley SK8 4LY
description: Deckchair Care's welcoming, dementia-friendly community café offers company, conversation and activities for older residents, carers and anyone who would enjoy some company. The listed sessions run 1pm–3pm. Dates are individually sourced; check with the organiser for any changes.

title: The Girl on the Train at Chads Theatre
venue: Chads Theatre, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5AU
description: Chads Theatre stages the suspense drama adapted from Paula Hawkins' novel. Evening shows are listed at 7.45pm, with an additional 2.30pm matinee on Saturday 24 October. No Sunday 18 October performance is listed. Confirm tickets and availability before attending.

title: CHESS at Stockport Plaza
venue: Stockport Plaza, Mersey Square, Stockport SK1 1SP
cost: Ticketed; see venue for current price and availability
description: Stockport Operatic Society presents the Cold War musical with music by Benny Andersson and Björn Ulvaeus and lyrics by Tim Rice. Evening performances are at 7.15pm, with an additional Saturday 24 October matinee at 2.15pm. Check the Plaza for ticket prices and remaining seats.

title: The Witch's Potion Trail at Bramall Hall
venue: Bramall Hall, Hall Road, Bramhall, Stockport SK7 3NX
cost: £3 per child trail + accompanying adult admission
description: A Halloween hunt through Bramall Hall for ages 3+, with a small prize for finding Batilda's ingredients. Sessions run 22–25 October and 27 October–1 November, 11am–3.30pm, with NO session on Monday 26 October. £3 per participating child plus accompanying adult admission; online booking fees can apply. Booking ahead is recommended; on-the-day entry is subject to space.

title: Free digital support drop-in at Cheadle Library
venue: Cheadle Library, 23 Ashfield Road, Cheadle SK8 1BB
description: Friendly volunteer help for beginners with websites, phones, tablets and other digital questions. The library says you can turn up without booking, but session times can change, so check before travelling.

title: Hazel Grove Model Railway Exhibition
venue: Woodford War Memorial Community Centre, Chester Road, Woodford SK7 1PS
cost: Adults £9; up to two accompanied under-16s free per paying adult (£4 otherwise)
description: Two days of working model railway layouts, traders and demonstrations. Free parking and a courtesy bus from Hazel Grove station. Earlier mobility access from 9.30am on Sunday; Sunday closes at 4pm.

title: Stockport Dads Club: October Half Term
venue: Stockroom, Merseyway Shopping Centre, Stockport SK1 1PR
cost: Free general event; under-2 sensory session £2
description: Half-term day for dads and father figures with children, including story time, den building, Lego, board games and table football. The under-2 sensory session costs £2 and includes a hot drink and barm.

title: Merseyday of the Dead
venue: Merseyway Shopping Centre and Redrock, Stockport town centre
cost: Free activities; food and other purchases extra
description: Saturday 24 October: Skullstock at Merseyway from noon to 3pm includes a spooky trail, crafts, sugar-skull glitter tattoos and performances. Deadrock at Redrock follows from 5pm to 7pm with trick-or-treating, dancing, games, slime and a Day of the Dead parade. Activities are subject to availability; check the programme before travelling.

title: Iconic drag show
venue: Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5AT
description: A live-singing drag tribute show built around songs from different music icons across the decades.

title: October half term at Jodrell Bank
venue: Jodrell Bank, Cheshire
description: Jodrell Bank confirms its 2026 half-term programme from 26 October to 1 November, including the Curious Kids science show, a choice of Space Dome films and The North Revisited exhibition. General admission is required; individual show times and extra charges vary, so check the daily schedule before booking.

title: BSL Signed Storytime
venue: Stockroom Studios, Merseyway Shopping Centre, Stockport SK1 1PR
description: Inclusive British Sign Language signed storytime for under-5s and families, delivered with the National Deaf Children's Society. Particularly suitable for children who are deaf, have hearing loss or additional communication needs.

title: Memory Lane at Cheadle Hulme Methodist Church
venue: Cheadle Hulme Methodist Church, Ramillies Avenue, Cheadle Hulme SK8 7AL
cost: Free; advance discussion and registration required
description: A supportive group for people with dementia accompanied by their carers, with conversation, reminiscence and optional activities. This is not a walk-in event: contact the church office on 0161 485 1605 to discuss the group and registration before attending.

title: Autumn Sensory Story Circle & Craft
venue: Stockroom Studios, Merseyway Shopping Centre, Stockport SK1 1PR
description: An inclusive sensory storytelling and optional craft session for disabled children and loved ones, using textures, gentle sounds and soft lighting. Places are limited; see the venue booking page before travelling.

title: Foodie Friday
venue: Market Place, Stockport SK1 1EW
cost: Free entry; food and drink extra
description: The organiser's 2026 dates confirm Friday 30 October. Street food, craft ales and live music at Stockport Market Place from 6pm to 9pm; entry is free, with purchases extra. Check programme changes before travelling.

title: Arc Saturday Art Club
venue: Arc at Hat Works, Wellington Road South, Stockport SK3 0EU
description: A family drop-in art club at Arc at Hat Works from 11am to 3pm, with activities designed for adults and children aged 3+. No booking is needed; a £3 charitable donation per artist is suggested for those who can afford it.

title: Fundraising Organ Coffee Morning at the Plaza
venue: Stockport Plaza, Mersey Square, Stockport SK1 1SP
description: Drop into Stockport Plaza for a free organ concert and coffee-morning atmosphere in its Art Deco auditorium. The venue lists the event from 11am until 2pm; check its What's On page for any changes.

title: Halloween Crafty Kids Pop Up
venue: Heald Green Library, Finney Lane, Heald Green, Cheadle SK8 3JB
description: A free Halloween craft drop-in for children of all ages at Heald Green Library on Saturday 31 October, 11.30am–12.30pm. No booking is listed; check for changes before travelling.

title: Cheadle Soul Club Halloween Special
venue: Cheadle & Gatley Conservative Club, 24 Stockport Road, Cheadle SK8 2AA
description: Northern soul, Motown and seventies soul for the Halloween special. The event listing says smart dress, no talc or drinks on the dancefloor, and no admission after 11pm. Check with the organiser before travelling.

title: T Kay: Soul and Motown
venue: Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5AT
description: A Saturday evening set of soul and Motown songs from singer T Kay. The club's official events diary lists an 8.45pm start and different entry prices for members and non-members; programme may change.

title: North Room live at Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club
venue: Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5AT
description: Local band North Room play a Saturday-night set at Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club, with the venue describing a wide range of music and free entry.

title: Christmas Craft Night at Cheadle Library
venue: Cheadle Library, 23 Ashfield Road, Cheadle, Stockport SK8 1BB
cost: Free; booking required; ages 16 and over
description: A free Christmas craft evening inspired by Agatha Christie and her connection to Cheadle. Make festive cards and decorations with a mystery, literary and Art Deco twist. The session is for ages 16 and over; book a place before travelling.
verification: Stockport Council's Christmas Craft Night listing, submitted by Cheadle Library, confirms Thursday 12 November 2026, 5:30pm to 7pm, a free event for ages 16+, and a Book a place action.

seo.access: For ages 16 and over. Booking is required even though the event is free.

title: Journey to the Dark Side of the UNE
venue: Jodrell Bank, Bomish Lane, Lower Withington, Macclesfield SK11 9DW
description: UNE, the electronic dream-pop and ambient duo of Mark Radcliffe and Paul Langley, perform inside Jodrell Bank's Space Dome with full-dome visuals and a space conversation with Professor Tim O'Brien. Doors open at 7pm and the event runs 7:30pm to 10pm.

title: Lum Head nursery and reception open day
venue: Lum Head Primary School, Troutbeck Road, Gatley SK8 4RR
description: Families considering nursery or reception places for September 2027 can look around Lum Head Primary School and meet staff. The school asks visitors to book a tour by calling 0161 428 7992 or emailing its school office.
verification: Stockport Council event listing (submitted by Lum Head Primary School) confirms Thursday 19 November 2026, 2pm to 3pm, free; school website requests advance booking through the office.

seo.access: Public open day for families considering nursery or reception in September 2027. Book a place with the school before visiting.

title: Liam Gallagher / Oasis tribute night
venue: Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5AT
description: Paul Hand performs a Liam Gallagher and Oasis tribute at the club, starting at 8.45pm. The venue's calendar says entry is free to members and £5 for non-members; check for changes before travelling.
